name: Junie
prerequisites: Junie CLI installed and on PATH as `junie` (JetBrains standalone launcher; the real binary lives under ~/.local/share/junie/.../junie.app/Contents/MacOS/junie); `junie --version` prints e.g. 'Junie version: 26.8.24 (2929.4) eap'
Auth via JetBrains AI account (login out-of-band on first run); no API key env var
Observe-only adapter: no hooks, no backchannel control. Sessions are read from ~/.junie/sessions/<session-id>/events.jsonl; PID binding via ~/.junie/processes/<pid>-<session-id>-<hash>.json sidecars
The events.jsonl schema is unversioned/undocumented (reverse-engineered 2026-08); re-verify event kinds against a live session after Junie updates
